application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
The proposed works include:
 Pruning overhanging branches from three Horse Chestnut trees
 Pruning overhanging branches from one Oak tree
 Minor crown reduction where required to reduce weight on extended limbs
 Removal of any dead or potentially hazardous branches
All works will be carried out by a qualified and insured tree surgeon and undertaken in accordance with appropriate arboricultural standards. No trees are intended to be removed.

Oak tree (with ivy)  left side, about 8 m forward from the rear fence
Horse Chestnut (left) rear left corner behind the oak
Horse Chestnut (centre/right) rear boundary
Horse Chestnut (far right)  rear right corner
